{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_sales = sales.loc[~qa_mask & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check final population
print(f'Final number of completed orders (excluding QA): {len(filtered_sales)}')

# Check channel distribution
print(filtered_sales['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print(filtered_sales.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
